def insert_record(db, scope_id, key, encoded, kind, sources, parents, changes,
                  *, state="active", replacements=()):
    record_id, now = _id(), _now()
    validate_parents(db, scope_id, parents, child_id=record_id)
    db.execute("INSERT INTO memories(id, scope_id, key, value_json, kind, state, revision, created_at, updated_at) "
               "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
               (record_id, scope_id, key, encoded, kind, state, 1, now, now))
    link_sources(db, scope_id, record_id, sources)
    for parent in parents:
        prev = row_or_404(db, scope_id, parent)["revision"]
        db.execute("INSERT INTO dependencies(scope_id, child_id, parent_id, parent_revision_at_use) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                   (scope_id, record_id, parent, prev))
    for old in replacements:
        db.execute("INSERT INTO replacements(scope_id, old_id, new_id, reason) VALUES (?,?,?,?)",
                   (scope_id, old, record_id, "replacement"))
    changes[record_id] = None
    return record_id


def publish_event(db, scope_id, event_type, actor_binding, changes, *, metadata=None):
    """Bump scope epoch once per change-set and write one event row, in-tx.
    metadata must NOT contain record bodies (refs only)."""
    if not changes:
        return scope_epoch(db, scope_id)
    epoch = scope_epoch(db, scope_id) + 1
    db.execute("UPDATE scopes SET epoch=? WHERE id=?", (epoch, scope_id))
    affected = sorted(changes.keys())
    db.execute("INSERT INTO events(id, scope_id, scope_epoch, event_type, actor_binding, affected_ids_json, metadata_json, created_at) "
               "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
               (_id(), scope_id, epoch, event_type, actor_binding, _json(affected),
                _json(metadata or {}), _now()))
    return epoch

def remember(db, scope_id, key, value, *, source_refs, kind="fact",
             parent_ids=(), expected_revision=None, replaces_ids=(),
             actor_binding="local"):
    scope_id, key = _text(scope_id, "scope"), _text(key, "key")
    if kind not in ("requirement", "fact", "decision", "attempt", "procedure", "handoff"):
        raise TurnkeepError("INVALID_INPUT", "Unknown memory kind")
    encoded = _json(value)
    sources = _sources(source_refs)
    parents = _ids(parent_ids)
    replaces = _ids(replaces_ids)
    with transaction(db, write=True):
        ensure_scope(db, scope_id)
        candidates = db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM memories WHERE scope_id=? AND key=? AND state IN ('active','conflicted') ORDER BY id",
            (scope_id, key)).fetchall()
        if any(r["kind"] != kind for r in candidates):
            raise TurnkeepError("KIND_MISMATCH", "One key must retain one declared kind")
        same = next((r for r in candidates if r["value_json"] == encoded), None)
        changes = {}
        if same is not None:
            if same["state"] == "conflicted":
                raise TurnkeepError("CONFLICT_REQUIRES_RESOLVE",
                                    "A matching conflicted value cannot be reused or merged")
            if replaces:
                raise TurnkeepError("INVALID_INPUT", "replaces_ids is only valid when creating a new record")
            old = dump_record(db, same)
            combined_sources = _sources(old["source_refs"] + sources)
            combined_parents = sorted(set(old["parent_ids"]) | set(parents))
            changed = combined_sources != old["source_refs"] or combined_parents != old["parent_ids"]
            if changed:
                check_revision(same, expected_revision)
